execution.meaning: the executor that ran the function (local, ray, none)
execution.name: executor_type

execution.meaning: the executor's own settings, as text
execution.name: executor_info

execution.meaning: the Python version that ran the function (3.12.3)
execution.name: python_version

execution.meaning: further facts about the run, as text; empty today
execution.name: extra_info

identity: the function's name: its __name__, or the function_name given
the hash of the output schema: each output key with its type, in no order
v<major> of the function's own version (the part before the first dot)
the type and its major: python.function.v1
run_rules: inputs are bound to the function's parameters by name, as keyword arguments
a parameter with a default may be left out of the inputs
the returned value is mapped to the output keys by position: one key takes the whole value, several keys take the items of a returned sequence
a function with no output keys (-> None or no return annotation) has no outputs; a returned value other than None is refused
a returned value must conform to its declared output type
variadic (*args, **kwargs) and positional-only parameters are refused

variation.meaning: the function's name, as in the uri
variation.name: function_name

variation.meaning: the full version string the function was declared with (v3.7)
variation.name: function_version

variation.covers: the function's module and name, each parameter's name, kind, annotation and default (the default's own hash), and the return annotation (docs/reference/hashing.md, 1d)
variation.meaning: the hash of the function used as a value
variation.name: function_signature_hash

variation.covers: the function's name and module, its source text as written (decorator lines, docstring, comments and whitespace included), its annotations sorted by name, and its code properties (argument counts, number of locals, argument names)
variation.meaning: the hash of the function's code
variation.name: function_content_hash

variation.meaning: the git commit of the function's file or working directory, with -dirty, -untracked and -<source> suffixes; unknown outside git
variation.name: git_hash
